intro: Türkçede hepsi "yapmak" ile söylendiği için make ve do sık karıştırılır. Doğru collocation kullanmak Lexical Resource puanını yükseltir; band 7 için "less common lexical items and collocation" gerekir.

sections.h: 1. make — bir şey ortaya çıkarmak, üretmek
p: Genel fikir: sonunda **yeni bir şey oluşuyorsa** make.
Ezberle: **make** a decision, a mistake, progress, an effort, money, a difference, a contribution, an improvement, a complaint, a suggestion, sense, an appointment.

ex.wrong: Many students do the same mistake.
ex.right: Many students make the same mistake.

p: Genel fikir: bir **iş veya görevi yerine getirmek**.
Ezberle: **do** research, homework, business, a course, exercise, sport, damage, harm, your best, the shopping, a favour, well/badly.

ex.wrong: Scientists have made a lot of research.
ex.right: Scientists have done a lot of research.
I do sport / exercise every day.

p: Bu hatalar examiner'ın gözünden kaçmaz ve hepsi kolayca düzeltilebilir.

ex.note: **discuss** doğrudan nesne alır; "a discussion about" ise doğrudur.

ex.wrong: Can you explain me this rule?
ex.right: Can you explain this rule to me?

ex.wrong: Could you make a photo of us?
ex.right: Could you take a photo of us?
In my view, … / I would argue that …

ex.wrong: Most people work to win money.
ex.right: Most people work to earn money.
ex.note: **win** = yarışma/piyango ile kazanmak; çalışarak kazanmak **earn** veya **make money**.

ex.wrong: In my opinion, I think that…
ex.right: In my opinion, … / I think that…
ex.note: Aynı fikri iki kez söylemek gereksiz tekrardır.

quiz.q: Governments must ___ more effort to reduce air pollution.
Scientists have ___ a great deal of research into ageing.
Using public transport can ___ a real difference to air quality.
Smoking ___ serious harm to your lungs.

options: Can you explain me this rule?
Can you explain this rule to me?
quiz.explain: **explain something to someone**: kişiden önce "to" gerekir.

quiz.q: Most people work in order to ___ money.
quiz.explain: Çalışarak para kazanmak: **earn** (veya make) money. **win** yarışma ve piyango içindir.

quiz.q: I usually ___ exercise three times a week.

options: Could you make a photo of us?
Could you take a photo of us?

quiz.q: Many students ___ the same mistake with articles.
